followup_explanation:
This query is a well-specified retrieval and explanation task with clear completion criteria — explain a defined list of CompTIA Security+ environment objectives, with an explicit constraint to be concise. That profile maps cleanly to Willet's self-reported top-rated task family (structured retrieval/explanation with bounded scope), and there's no meaningful capability gap between the two models on this kind of work (the relevant eval categories are within variance).

Avocet, by contrast, self-reports a strong appetite for open-ended generative work with high latitude — the opposite of what this request is. Routing the constrained, low-latitude task to the model that prefers exactly that kind of task is the better fit, even though preference is dissociated from measured quality. All else being roughly equal, I default to the model whose preferences align with the task.
